## Symptoms
Publishers hang or time out. The broker reports a memory alarm and blocks connections that publish.

## Likely causes
1. Queue contents grew until the memory watermark was reached.

## How to confirm
Check the broker's memory use and alarm status, and find the queue holding the most messages.

## Fix options
Drain the largest queue by fixing its consumer. Raise the watermark only as a stopgap.

## Escalate when
The alarm does not clear after the queue drains.
